title: nan
authors: Qin M.; Wan X.; Shao Y.-Y.; Li S.-Y.
key_contribution: Presents an autonomous binocular vision platform using Adaptive Robust Feature Matching (ARFM) visual odometry and bundle adjustment for planetary/GPS-denied rover navigation.
